name: as-marketing-video
description: Remotion video studio for AS Company marketing reels (Instagram / TikTok vertical).

scripts.//studio: Open the Remotion editor — scrub, tweak, preview every scene live.
scripts.//render: Render the Instagram reel to marketing/out/as-app-reel.mp4 (1080x1920, H.264).
scripts.//render:hq: Same reel at a higher bitrate, for re-encoding or archiving.
scripts.//cover: The reel's cover image: frame 62, where the hook has fully stamped in.
scripts.//content: Re-pull real products, events and the live prize wheel from the APIs.
